verdict.rationale: Edge0 has a command-line interface (`edge0 serve`, one-shot chat with `--max-new`, `--no-prerouter`/`--no-lora`). However, the evidence shows no flag to set GPU offload amounts or context length. Its SSD expert offload is an automatic streaming mechanism, not a user setting, and `--max-new` caps generated output length rather than setting the model's context window, so both are only adjacent features.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
